claims.gist: By 2025, 40% of boards will have a dedicated cybersecurity committee
Cybersecurity ranks as second-highest enterprise risk in the 2020 board survey
By 2024, 60% of CISOs will partner with sales, finance and marketing executives
By 2025, half of asset-intensive firms will merge cyber and physical security under one CSO
Security capabilities can be delivered remotely, as the pandemic showed
By 2022, 30% of security teams will permanently increase remote staff
Security leaders should widen job ads beyond traditional recruitment geographies

thesis: Cyber risk will reshape boards, CISO roles, security convergence and remote security staffing through 2025.
